examples.title: BH/BY adjusted p-values
changes: Independently authored stdlib implementation of published BH/BY mathematics; no historical code excerpt.
One-dimensional lists replace NumPy arrays; finite complete-family inputs are required.
Missing or invalid p-values raise ValueError instead of silently excluding them from ranks.
Hand-computed synthetic families and structural invariants are checked.
limitations: FDR interpretation requires valid p-values and a correctly declared complete family; BH dependence assumptions remain necessary.

examples.title: Gross/net basis points and fixed initial R
changes: Independently authored elementary unit and signed P&L arithmetic; no source code excerpt.
No Sharpe/CAGR helpers, source cost model, tax rules, statutory defaults or TradeX-derived implementation.
Caller supplies complete round-trip cost; initial R excludes costs and stays fixed.
Synthetic long/short examples verify signs, scale invariance, cost subtraction once and losses beyond one R.
limitations: No historical gross/net reconstruction or execution model.
Net R is distinct from the source screener target net-risk/reward ratio.

examples.title: One-way clustered uncertainty for a mean
changes: Independently authored stdlib intercept-only CR1 formula; no event-study source excerpt.
No database, panels, event construction, return labels, fillability, two-way estimator or study gates.
One-cluster and empty-sample uncertainty is None; invalid observations are rejected explicitly.
Synthetic cluster replication and unique-cluster comparison checks exercise dependence arithmetic.
limitations: No p-value, confidence interval or strategy verdict.
Independent clusters and suitable asymptotics are required; a two-cluster teaching example does not support empirical inference.

examples.title: Finite positive bridge and explicit-input repair
changes: Independently authored ratio check and explicit-factor Decimal reconstruction; no audit/adjustment source excerpt.
Synthetic raw close 0.04, split factor 100 and total-return factor 1.02 are supplied as unrounded decimal strings.
50-digit working precision avoids the illustrative two-decimal rounding-to-zero failure; no exact-arithmetic guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
No factor inference, price cliffs, proprietary raw rows, corporate-action records or source-rights certification.
limitations: Cannot recover a lost raw value or factor from rounded zeros.
Technical finite-positive validity alone cannot certify provenance, licensing, causality or execution.

examples.title: Prior-session R² and training-only fold calibration
changes: Independently authored stdlib direct centered-sum log-price/time R²; no historical vectorized engine excerpt.
Small rolling synthetic windows use exactly prices[t-window:t]; no source strategy rules, event generation or manifests.
Fold teaching contract includes explicit feature availability at t-1 and strict train/validation separation.
None preserves missing/flat features and zero-variance standardization; missing training values are counted.
Synthetic future-mutation checks and hand-calculated terciles verify leakage boundaries.
limitations: No historical engine parity, actual exchange calendar or PIT-vintage verification.
No quality-performance relationship, return regression, parameter search or new research inference.
